Operations Manager Job at Zinance Limited




        
    

        
        Zinance Limited is a dynamic Information Technology and Consulting firm committed to delivering innovative digital solutions and strategic advisory services to businesses of all sizes. We combine technical expertise with industry insight to help organizations improve performance, streamline operations, and achieve sustainable growth.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Operations Manager 

Job Locations: Lagos and Ogun

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are looking for a professional Operations Manager to coordinate and oversee our organization’s operationsformulate strategy, improving performance, procuring material and resources and securing compliance.
	You should be ready to mentor your team members, find ways to increase quality of customer service and implement best practices across all levels.


Responsibilities


	Ensure all operations are carried on in an appropriate, cost-effective way
	Improve operational management systems, processes and best practices
	Purchase materials, plan inventory and oversee warehouse efficiency
	Help the organization’s processes remain legally compliant
	Formulate strategic and operational objectives
	Examine financial data and use them to improve profitability
	Manage budgets and forecasts
	Perform quality controls and monitor production KPIs
	Recruit, train and supervise staff
	Find ways to increase quality of customer service


Requirements and skills


	Knowledge of organizational effectiveness and operations management
	Experience budgeting and forecasting
	Familiarity with business and financial principles
	Excellent communication skills
	Leadership ability
	Outstanding organisational skills


Salary
N120,000 - N180,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

title: Job Openings at Givanas Cosmetics Nigeria Limited
content:
Givanas Cosmetics Nigeria Limited, a manufacturing company, is recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Logistics Manager

 Job Location: Lagos
Department: Supply Chain
Reports to: Supply Chain Manager

Responsibilities
Key Result Areas:
Logistics Planning and Coordination:
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Develop and implement logistics plans in line with the company's supply chain objectives and the approved demand and production plans.
	Plan the movement of raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods, including inbound supplier deliveries and outbound deliveries to branches, distributors, and customers.


Transportation and Distribution Management:


	Manage the company's transportation and distribution operations.
	Plan delivery routes to optimise time, vehicle utilisation, fuel consumption, and transportation costs.


Stock Transfers and Warehouse Interface:


	Coordinate with the Warehouse Managers to ensure efficient movement of goods into and out of all warehouses.
	Ensure every inter-branch stock movement is supported by an approved Inventory Transfer (or Inventory Transfer Request) in SAP Business One and a waybill.


Fleet Management:


	Manage the company's logistics fleet and ensure optimal utilisation.
	Develop and enforce preventive maintenance schedules for company vehicles and forklifts, in coordination with the Maintenance team.


Cost Management:


	Prepare and manage the logistics budget.
	Monitor transportation, fuel, fleet maintenance, and distribution costs, and investigate significant cost variances.


Delivery and Customer Service:


	Ensure finished products are delivered to customers, distributors, and branches within agreed timelines.
	Monitor delivery performance and resolve logistics-related complaints.


Compliance, Safety and Risk Management:


	Ensure logistics activities comply with applicable Nigerian transportation, road safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements.
	Ensure all vehicles, drivers, and forklift operators hold valid documentation, licences, and certifications.


Systems and Data:


	Ensure logistics transactions and delivery information are updated accurately and promptly in SAP Business One.
	Use fleet tracking/GPS and other logistics tools where available.


Team Management and Development:


	Lead, supervise, and develop the Drivers, Forklift Operators, and any other logistics staff.
	Agree with the Warehouse Managers on the day-to-day deployment of Forklift Operators at each warehouse.


Reporting and Documentation:


	Prepare weekly and monthly logistics performance reports for the Supply Chain Manager.


Report on delivery performance, transportation costs, fleet utilisation, fuel consumption, vehicle downtime, and logistics incidents.

KPI
The Logistics Manager will be assessed against the following key performance indicators:


	On-time delivery rate (customers, distributors, and branches).
	Branch replenishment transfers delivered on schedule.
	Transportation cost per unit/load and logistics cost as a percentage of sales.
	Vehicle utilisation rate, fleet availability, and downtime.
	Fuel consumption efficiency.
	Dispatch accuracy and goods-in-transit variances.
	Product damage and loss rate in transit.
	Delivery-related customer complaints.
	Transporter performance.
	Logistics budget adherence.
	Vehicle and forklift maintenance compliance.
	Safety and accident rates.
	Proof-of-delivery return rate and documentation compliance.
	Returns/reverse logistics turnaround time.


Qualification and Experience


	Minimum of 5–8 years of relevant logistics experience, preferably within a manufacturing, FMCG, or distribution environment.
	At least 2–3 years in a supervisory or managerial role.
	Demonstrable experience managing transportation, fleet operations, multi-location distribution, and logistics service providers.
	Experience with SAP Business One or a similar ERP system is desirable.


Salary
N600,000 monthly.

Application Closing Date: 20th November, 2026. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: [email protected] using "Logistics Manager" as the subject of the email.

 

 

2.) Regional Sales Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and executing regional sales strategies, managing sales teams, building strong customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and consistently achieving revenue and market share targets.
	The ideal candidate should have strong commercial acumen, excellent leadership skills, a proven track record in sales, and a good understanding of the cosmetics and Lagos market.


Responsibilities
Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth:


	Develop and implement effective regional sales strategies aligned with company objectives.
	Drive revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and market-share growth within the assigned territory.
	Set and monitor monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
	Identify new markets, customer segments, products, and revenue opportunities.
	Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing, and customer needs.


Team Leadership & Management:


	Lead, coach, motivate, and develop the regional sales team.
	Set individual and team sales targets and performance expectations.
	Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
	Identify training and development needs and support continuous improvement.
	Promote accountability, discipline, teamwork, and a strong performance culture.


Business Development:


	Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the region.
	Build relationships with key customers, distributors, retailers, corporate clients, and strategic partners.
	Develop and maintain a strong regional sales pipeline.
	Negotiate commercial agreements and contracts within approved company guidelines.
	Strengthen customer retention and increase repeat business.


Territory & Distribution Management:


	Develop and maintain effective territory coverage plans.
	Manage distributors, dealers, agents, and other sales channels where applicable.
	Ensure products/services are adequately represented and available across the region.
	Monitor distribution, stock levels, sales activities, and route-to-market effectiveness.
	Identify gaps in market coverage and implement corrective actions.


Sales Performance & Reporting:


	Track regional sales performance against targets and budgets.
	Prepare accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales reports.
	Analyse sales data and use insights to improve performance.
	Forecast sales and provide management with reliable market intelligence.
	Recommend strategies to address under-performing territories, products, or sales channels.


Customer & Stakeholder Management:


	Maintain strong relationships with key customers and stakeholders.
	Handle escalated customer issues and ensure timely resolution.
	Represent the company at relevant meetings, trade events, exhibitions, and industry activities.
	Gather customer feedback and communicate market insights to management and other departments.


Compliance & Operational Excellence:


	Ensure the sales team operates in accordance with company policies and procedures.
	Maintain accurate customer, sales, and territory records.
	Monitor sales expenses and ensure effective use of company resources.
	Ensure compliance with applicable Nigerian laws, regulations, and industry requirements.


Requirements


	Interested candidates should possess relevant qualifications and experience.


Application Closing Date: 16th November, 2026.

Method of Application 

Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: [email protected] using "Regional Sales Manager" as the subject of the email.

BuySales Leads

Note: Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for interview.

 

 

3.) Modern Trade Sales Executive

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)

Job Summary


	We are working on recruiting an experienced Modern Trade Sales Executives to join our team.
	The successful candidates will have a strong background in FMCG sales, with a focus on modern trade.


Key Responsibilities
Sales Growth and Development:


	Achieve sales targets and drive growth in assigned territories.
	Identify new business opportunities and develop strategies to capitalize on them.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, including modern trade accounts.


Customer Relationship Management:


	Develop and execute customer-specific sales plans to drive growth and increase market share.
	Provide excellent customer service, responding promptly to customer inquiries and resolving issues effectively.
	Identify and capitalize on opportunities to upsell and cross-sell products.


Sales Strategy Execution:


	Execute sales strategies and plans to achieve sales targets and drive growth.
	Monitor and analyze sales data to identify trends and opportunities for growth.
	Adjust sales strategies as needed to respond to changes in the market or competitive landscape.


Territory Management:


	Manage assigned territories, including planning and executing sales calls, and maintaining accurate records of sales activity.
	Identify and prioritize key customers and opportunities within assigned territories.


Other responsibilities include but not limited to the following:


	Conduct market research to identify selling possibilities and evaluate customer needs.
	Set sales goals and determine the best ways to achieve them.
	Meet with customers and determine their need for goods and services; recommend products; and process transactions.
	Ensure the availability of stock for sales and demonstrations.
	Negotiate / close deals and handle complaints or objections.
	Collaborate with team members to achieve better results.
	Gather feedback from customers or prospects and share with internal teams.


Requirements


	Minimum 4 years of experience in FMCG sales, with a focus on modern trade.
	Proven track record of driving sales growth and achieving sales targets.
	Strong understanding of sales principles, practices, and techniques.
	Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
	Experience working with modern trade accounts, such as supermarkets and hypermarkets.
	Knowledge of the FMCG industry and market trends and the following superstores: H-medix, Sahad, Next Cash n Carry, Classic.


Application Closing Date: 10th November, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using "MODERN TRADE SALES EXECUTIVE - ABUJA" as the subject of the email.
